scope: Purposeful twelve-target Waterwheel road-delivery rhythm plus exact-source normal-input delivery qualification. Preview remains non-awarding and is not an eight-route campaign replacement.

native.recipe: Real preview UI and 3D inspection; supported 2D complete CPU route; ordinary rightward riding; coast into a forward 35-145px throw window; sampled standard Xbox B; wait for real packet collision; resume riding. No player-position, velocity, delivery, score, win, record or document assignments.

retained_failures.details: South Quay delivered genuinely. Parcel Market became the correct nearest mailbox, but a paper fired immediately on entering the outer 250px eligibility radius at full throttle missed. Rider stayed alive/on-road on the first attempt, and later mailboxes remained targetable. The physical throw inherits rider momentum and is intentionally not auto-solved. The next source uses ordinary coasting into a declared readable throw window instead of assigning delivery state.

Initial rules compared codec objects from an isolated VM realm with Node strict prototype equality. Serialized values were identical. Test oracle now compares encoded values while keeping codec and Workshop validation unchanged.

Readable stereo menu showed Controller guide in the optional first-page slot instead of Portal atlas. Background, text contrast, scenery isolation, tracked input, hand and award-isolation checks are unchanged.
